tetrahedra and trace ﬁeld F61 = Q(α) where α = 1.5041 · · · −1.2268 . . . i is a root of
x4 −2x3 + x2 + 3x + 1 = 0
F61 is of type [0, 2] with discriminant 257, a prime. We chose to give the data for this knot
because the Bloch group of its trace ﬁeld is a ﬁnitely generated abelian group of rank 2. The
1-loop invariant at k = 1 and its norm is given by
